messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need someone to press prod tonight during the 22:00-23:00 UTC change window. Canary pin v2.3.1 is queued. Deploy bot currently shows no claim. MFA for svc-deployer looked flaky earlier. Who can press? @ben @sam?

deploy-bot: [automated] current claim: none. To claim: `deploy-bot claim --env=prod --duration=2h`

ben: I can take primary if Sam can't, but my MFA device is being replaced — will need JIT elevation. Will confirm by 21:45 UTC.

jordan: Quick check — is there a documented rollback for v2.3.1? I saw a small db migration in the notes. If rollback is needed we should pin v2.3.0 as the immediate fallback. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/v2.3.1

sam: I can run the canary press (5% traffic) and monitor. Plan: claim -> pin -> start canary 5% for 30m -> promote if stable. I'll hold off claiming until MFA validated. Also suggest adding a temporary canary metric watch: /ops/alerts/canary-latency

maya: Thanks. Jordan — migration looks additive but we still need a rollback path in case latency/regressions spike. Sam, can you paste the claim + rollout commands you'll use?

sam: command: 
```
deploy-bot claim --env=prod --owner=sam --reason="canary press v2.3.1" --ttl=2h
```
then
```
deploy-bot pin-version --env=prod --service=frontend --version=v2.3.1
deploy-bot rollout --env=prod --service=frontend --percent=5 --monitor=canary-latency --duration=30m
```

ben: FYI my JIT request is in: https://idm.redwood/jit/REQ-321. If Sam is primary, I'll be backup and will handle rollback if needed.

maya: Decision: Sam primary, Ben backup. Sam to claim by 21:55 UTC and start canary at 22:00. Everyone, verify MFA/IAM access now. React with :thumbsup: if you see no blockers.

jordan: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [automated] claim recorded: owner=sam ts=4758890005 ttl=7200s

sam: Claimed and pinned. Starting canary in 5m. Will post metrics to the thread and to /ops/canary-dashboard.

maya: Copy — thanks. If canary fails, Ben to execute rollback: 
```
deploy-bot rollback --env=prod --service=frontend --to-version=v2.3.0 --reason="canary failure"
```
and notify #incidents.

ben: Roger.
